name: pro.hdmatrix/hdmatrix
title: HD Matrix: Human Design
description: Human Design charts, compatibility, transits and interpretations. Free, no auth.

tools.name: calculate_chart
tools.description: Calculate a complete Human Design chart from a birth date, time and city: type, strategy, authority, profile, incarnation cross, definition, defined/open centers, channels and every planetary gate.line. Returns `chart_url` — a link that opens the full interactive bodygraph for this person on hdmatrix.pro; share it with the user.

name.description: Optional: the person's name, shown on the chart

time.description: Birth time in local time, 24h HH:MM, e.g. 14:05. If truly unknown use 12:00 and say the chart is approximate

latitude.description: Optional: latitude, if already known (skips geocoding)

locale.description: Language for names and the link: en, uk, ru, de, es, pt, fr… Default en

tools.name: get_compatibility
tools.description: Compare two people (a Human Design composite / relationship chart): which channels they complete together (electromagnetic), share (companionship), or where one conditions the other (compromise, dominance), how many of the 9 centers the pair defines, and each person's type and profile.

name.description: Optional: the person's name, shown on the chart

time.description: Birth time in local time, 24h HH:MM, e.g. 14:05. If truly unknown use 12:00 and say the chart is approximate

latitude.description: Optional: latitude, if already known (skips geocoding)

name.description: Optional: the person's name, shown on the chart

time.description: Birth time in local time, 24h HH:MM, e.g. 14:05. If truly unknown use 12:00 and say the chart is approximate

latitude.description: Optional: latitude, if already known (skips geocoding)

tools.name: get_transits
tools.description: Human Design transits. With no arguments: where the Sun, Moon and planets stand right now (gate.line each) — the collective 'weather'. With a person's birth data: also which of today's transits touch that person's chart.

name.description: Optional: the person's name, shown on the chart

time.description: Birth time in local time, 24h HH:MM, e.g. 14:05. If truly unknown use 12:00 and say the chart is approximate

latitude.description: Optional: latitude, if already known (skips geocoding)

tools.name: geocode_place
tools.description: Resolve a city / place name to coordinates. Rarely needed — calculate_chart geocodes by itself; use this only to disambiguate between several places with the same name.

tools.name: get_interpretation
tools.description: Get the Human Design interpretation text for one element. Valid types: type, type_extended, authority, profile, profile_line, cross, cross_quantum, cross_variant, gate, gate_line, channel, center_defined, center_undefined, planet, planet_gate (key 'Planet:gate', e.g. 'Mars:34' — how a planet expresses a gate in a birth chart), gene_key, transit_gate, phs_diet, phs_env, phs_motivation, phs_view, cognition, notself, signature, strategy.

locale.description: Locale (en, uk, ru, de, es, pt, fr…), default en

tools.name: list_interpretation_keys
tools.description: Discover all available interpretation keys, optionally for one type. Use this to find exact keys before calling get_interpretation.

type.description: Optional: a single type to enumerate
